cholera.notes: Canonical profile = logical OR across all listed gold .compmodel files for this disease, then disease-folder priors merged (OR). Same assignment is written under reports/disease_feature_models/<slug>.json as the gold-derived disease feature model. Signals prefixed with [prior] were set by apply_disease_name_hints(), not by regex matches on the compmodel text.
